notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
New content: 

• Zombie Goats: Now if you play as the chupacabra, you can convert goats into zombies
• Added Stormy Night
• Added explosive barrels on Industrial zone and military camp
• Improved "How to play section"
• Now you can drop items
• New item: drone, this item can track the chupacabra

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Added: Explosive Mine

Changes:
Now you can select up to 3 chupacabras per game.
Heal up for the monster now increment 25% of the health.
Damage splash screen now also appear if you are controlling the monster.

Bugs Fixed:
Hunter Player bug when switching weapons while running.

notes.title: Small Update 1.1
notes.content:
New Weapon added:[b] Flamethrower[/b]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can walk sideways
[*] Grenade Launcher damage decreased 40%
[*] Rifle damage increased x2
[*] Now when you die you respawn as an espectator in the same point where you died
[*] Now goats health are displayed if you are playing as the monster
[*] Now you need to guide goats to the barn for save them
[*] Goats sound distance increased
[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Audio volume and mouse sensitivity by was default 0
[*] Sometimes radio tower keys spawn on a unreacheable place
[/list]
